sourceDiagnosis.diagnosis: TdP in prolonged-QT setting; source QTc 0.63 ± 0.08 s, preceding-rhythm statement >0.60 s.

alignment.method: Visual waveform comparison with the published Figure 2, using header clock mapping and distinctive complexes.
alignment.limits: The printed figure strip starts18:12:50, while its TdP asterisk appears later. No exact onset is inferred from that label or from the header vfon comment. The crop ends within the graphically matched published strip; no later VF or termination label is assigned.

beatFiducials: Not supplied. Source47.ari is unaudited and is not used to assert reliable QRS onsets in the polymorphic segment.
